dedupe_keys.name: ngi top10vector belgian 1 10 000 vector topographic data with road rail waterway and high voltage networks

description: Top10Vector is the vector topographic reference dataset of Belgium, produced by the Nationaal Geografisch Instituut (NGI-IGN). Contents: 35 object classes grouped in eight themes: the road network, the rail network, hydrography (including commercially navigable waterways, handled as a third transport network), the high-voltage electricity network, constructions, land cover and vegetation, local relief and special zones. The transport networks are modelled as networks with nodes, bridges and tunnels and kilometre posts, so that the relations between crossing networks are kept, as described in the product specification. Coverage: the whole of Belgium at 1:10,000 reference scale, in the Lambert 2008 projection. Format and access: free download from the NGI download portal (ac.ngi.be) and discovery through geo.be, the federal geoportal; a detailed product specification in Dutch and French documents every class and attribute. Licence: NGI's free open data are released under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 with the attribution '© NGI-IGN, year'; free, as NGI publishes its high-value datasets under the EU implementing regulation 2023/138. Caveats: the high-voltage network is topographic (lines and pylons) without electrical attributes; update cycles differ by theme and the download portal needs page scripts, so it was not browsed here. Simulation uses: national road, rail, waterway and transmission line geometry for Belgian hazard exposure, network flow and interdependency models. Related records: Infrabel's railway telecom statistics (data-infrabel-railway-telecom-network-statistics) give operator data for the rail network.
